model.name: openonerec-illustrative-1.7b
model.calibration_note: Illustrative 2P linear FLOPs for 1.7B active parameters; 24 layers x 2048 KV width in BF16 and three 8192-entry codebooks. These dimensions/codebooks are not specified in the manuscript. Calibrate against the intended OpenOneRec checkpoint.

metadata.source: User-provided manuscript, Sections II-IV, Eqs. (1)-(6); user specifies exactly three semantic decoding steps
metadata.capacity_derivation: 7 x 512 GB minus 3.4 GB illustrative BF16 weights; decimal GB. One separate 36 GB HBM stack is the active workspace. HBM-only/CPU variants additionally reserve 36 GB HBM for active KV.
metadata.scope: One ASTRA NPU; FCFS requests, chunked prefill, per-layer projection/attention/output DAGs. Explicit weight/KV traffic. Whole-user cache capacities exclude weights and a 36 GB active KV workspace. Coefficients and projection split require calibration; activations and kernel launch overhead are not modeled.
